summary: Compared the expanded-product product-tabs reference, rendered crop, diff, retained state scope, and geometry. The active 'Stosowanie' state is present, but tab geometry/typography differ and the product-tabs marker spans 3,162 px instead of the retained 494 px component boundary.
issues: VIS-PRODUCT-EXPANDED-TABS-001 (high) — property: state component bounds; expected: product-tabs x=240, y=1096, width=1440, height=494, with expanded description tracked separately by the state scope; actual: x=240, y=1096.75, width=1440, height=3162; fix: bound data-factory-section='product-tabs' to the intended tab component and keep expanded-description ownership distinct.

VIS-PRODUCT-EXPANDED-TABS-002 (high) — property: active tab placement/width; expected: green 'Stosowanie' tab from about x=486 to x=710 within the crop; actual: it runs from about x=576 to x=864; fix: match the reference five-column tab distribution and 224 px active-tab width.

VIS-PRODUCT-EXPANDED-TABS-003 (high) — property: panel offset; expected: bordered content panel begins around y=91; actual: it begins around y=56, shifting content roughly 31–35 px upward; fix: restore source tab-to-panel spacing and panel padding.

VIS-PRODUCT-EXPANDED-TABS-004 (medium) — property: typography/wrapping; expected: source text metrics and line breaks; actual: rendered body text is smaller/heavier and wraps into longer lines; fix: apply exact source font size, weight, line-height, and content width.
